terms.label: Operational objective
terms.definition: Measurable intended improvement for a scoped factory activity with an owner, baseline, target and evaluation window.
terms.note: Provides purpose for existing runtime tasks; does not replace their requested outcome or lifecycle.

terms.label: ValueCreating
terms.definition: Activity that directly transforms the product or service toward a customer requirement.
terms.note: Classify the activity in context, not the asset or its utilization.

terms.label: NecessaryNonValueAdding
terms.definition: Activity that does not directly add customer value but is currently required to sustain value creation under documented constraints.
terms.note: Necessity is conditional on the current layout, process and requirements; review when constraints change.

terms.label: AvoidableWaste
terms.definition: Activity or portion of activity that can be removed without impairing required output, material readiness or applicable constraints.
terms.note: Separate avoidable distance, waiting and double handling from necessary transport.

terms.label: MaterialAvailability
terms.definition: Required material is usable at the required location, quantity and time.
terms.note: Measure readiness at point of use, not merely mission completion.

terms.label: FlowContinuity
terms.definition: Sustain planned production flow with fewer material-related interruptions.
terms.note: Distinguish material starvation from equipment faults and downstream blocking.

terms.label: LaborRelease
terms.definition: Reduce human time needed for an activity so capacity can be reassigned.
terms.note: Released hours are not automatically payroll savings; include residual handling, supervision and recovery.

terms.label: WaitingReduction
terms.definition: Reduce time that material, equipment or personnel waits for required process inputs or transfers.
terms.note: Specify whose waiting, its cause and the observation window.

terms.label: ExcessTransportReduction
terms.definition: Reduce movement beyond the feasible necessary transport for the required flow.
terms.note: Use comparable loads and output; include empty travel and double handling.

terms.label: WIPReduction
terms.definition: Reduce material committed to unfinished production while sustaining required service and output.
terms.note: Do not reduce buffers below the material-readiness requirement.

terms.label: ErgonomicRiskReduction
terms.definition: Reduce assessed exposure to manual handling strain in the selected work.
terms.note: Requires site-specific assessment; this objective is neither a safety function nor evidence of compliance.
